title: Kagamine Rin — No Head Pats, Thank You!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've all finished making our cards, let's start exchanging them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Man, I suddenly feel a bit shy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-Me too.
It's a little embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aw, really? Well, in that case...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll just have to show you all how it's done, one more time!
Starting with... Miku-P!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Here you are☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Thank you for always playing music and hanging out with me! I love how you're so kind and always look out for everyone around you! I hope we get to stay friends forever♪”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think I'm blushing a little bit...
But it is nice to be told that you're appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Now it's my turn.
Here you are, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow!
Is this the synth I always use?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Check it out, you guys! She used black and white tape to make the keys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. That's pretty clever, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, don't show it to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But this screams artistic talent!
I want everybody to see it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, I'm glad that you like it so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's follow Rin's example and start exchanging our cards!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... Then, Luka, I'll start with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here you are. I went with a night theme, since you're always so cool and collected.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
This is wonderful. I like how you have this staff of notes floating in the night sky.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... This is for you, MEIKO. I hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, this is incredible!
A drum kit popped out when I opened it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I went with a dynamic design, since you always put on such powerful performances.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you for this, Honami.
Now, here's the card I made for you. I hope you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Again, this is really embarrassing...
Can't we just count to three and exchange them like that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, one, two...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, is this a picture of the guitar I always use? Man, you're such a good artist.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The ice cream you drew also looks delicious, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hehe. Everyone's having so much fun☆ Alright, I think it's time to...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki! Shih!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I still haven't given you two your cards yet.
So, here you are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, this is so cute...!
Flowers, stars and all sorts of other stickers!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're always smiling and full of energy, so I decided to design a card with the same level of cheerfulness! I hope it brightens up your day every time you look at it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For your card, Shih, I used a bunch of animal stickers since I know you love them a lot☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see. These are really cute.
And you put on a lot of different species too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for putting so much thought into this. I promise to cherish it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, it's our turn now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I love your cheerful energy and how you're always the life of the party!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I hope we get to keep doing lots and lots of fun stuff together, and I hope we can be friends forever♪”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, here you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Wow, this card's decorations are so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're always chock-full of cheerful energy, so I decided to use sparkly stickers and glittery lamé!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Next is mine...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “I know I'm always telling you to look before you leap, but I do stand to learn a lot from your fearlessness and creativity.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Your cheerfulness has been a big source of encouragement for me. Thank you for always helping us put on great performances, and I hope we get to do more stuff like this moving forward.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, here. This is for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Shih, I see what you did!
This card looks simple, but it's put together really well☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: These stickers around the edge are tiny, but they're all lined up perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She used tweezers and a ruler to do that.
You should've seen how serious she looked while putting them on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I can't begin to describe how happy I feel right now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (These cards are great, but so are the messages that they wrote. I can tell just how much thought they both put into these...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thank you both so much!
I promise to treasure these!
